description: This Java class 'FiringOrderTSLogic' reads firing order definitions from a header file and processes them to generate logic expressions for ignition pin firing sequences based on cylinder IDs. It includes methods for reading external firing order data and generating logic conditions for each cylinder.

classes.name: FiringOrderTSLogic
classes.description: A class that reads and processes firing order definitions from a header file to generate ignition logic conditions for cylinders.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that initiates firing order reading and processes cylinder IDs 2 through 12.

methods.name: readFiringOrders
methods.description: Reads firing order data from the external header file and maps ASCII orders to integer ordinals.

methods.name: processId
methods.description: Generates logical expressions for a given cylinder ID based on the firing orders.
